text:
Marta L.: quick design review — thinking about swapping the big min/max slider for a compact stepper + preset buttons for 'burst' and 'reserved'. Feels less error-prone on mobile.
David K.: +1 to stepper for keyboard users. Slider is pretty but imprecise for low counts.
Aria S.: can we keep a small readout with estimated cost per hour next to it? people always ask price when changing min/max. :money_with_wings:
Raj P.: UX nit: copy currently says 'min tokens' in one place and 'min capacity' in another — should be consistent. propose `min instances` / `max instances`.
Marta L.: agreed on copy. Also naming of burst — product uses 'burst' and infra docs call it 'burst capacity'. Which do we standardize on?
David K.: prefer 'burst capacity' (clearer). Short label for compact mode can be 'Burst'.
Aria S.: accessibility: ensure stepper buttons have aria-labels like `Increase min instances` / `Decrease min instances`. Also tab order must be logical (min -> max -> burst -> pool).
Raj P.: edge case: when a customer pins a model to a dedicated pool with smaller size, the UI should warn if min > pool size. we had a bug where validation failed silently.
Marta L.: right — show an inline warning: `Selected pool capacity is lower than min instances. Adjust min or choose a different pool.` and offer a one-click fix button 'Match pool max'.
DesignBot: design suggestion generated: compact stepper + presets — attached sketch in figma (link) — https://figma.com/s/rwx/compact-minmax-presets
Aria S.: copy proposal for presets: `Reserved (predictable)`, `Burst (occasional)`, `Auto (sustained)` — thoughts?
David K.: 'Auto (sustained)' reads weird. maybe `Auto (adaptive)` or `Auto-scale`.
Marta L.: `Auto (adaptive)` 👍. Also consider a tiny help tooltip: `Reserved: capacity kept warm. Burst: temporary overcommit for spikes.`
Raj P.: implementation note: when burst is enabled, backend exposes `burst_ratio`. UI should show the effective max = `max_instances * (1 + burst_ratio)`. Maybe display `max (with burst): 12`.
Aria S.: can we show that as muted text under the max field? e.g., `Max instances — 10 (with burst: 15)`
David K.: validation: prevent setting min > effective max. If user does, show inline error: `Min must be <= effective max (15)`. Keep messages short and actionable.
Marta L.: mobile layout: replace horizontal pool picker with a dropdown + search. For desktop keep the horizontal pill group. Pill group should show pool health (green/yellow/red dot) and region.
Raj P.: pool labels: show `pool-name • A100-80GB • us-west-2` — matches infra taxonomy. Avoid long names; truncate with tooltip.
Aria S.: keyboard-only flow check: open pool dropdown -> type -> arrow -> enter selects -> focus returns to next control (SLO slider). Also SLO slider must be operable with arrow keys and have numeric input fallback.
Marta L.: SLO slider guardrails: if user moves slider below recommended threshold, show subtle warning bar: `Lowering SLO may increase latency and cost.` Provide a link `Learn more` to docs. Keep it non-blocking.
David K.: a11y color contrast: the warning yellow used earlier fails contrast at 14px. bump to AA contrast or add icon + text.
Raj P.: copy tweak for error states: prefer verbs e.g., `Choose a larger GPU pool` instead of passive voice.
Marta L.: final callouts: 1) stepper + presets default for compact inline editor, 2) keep slider for visual, but hide it behind 'advanced view', 3) consistent naming `min instances` / `max instances` / `burst capacity`, 4) explicit effective max calc and validation, 5) a11y fixes for contrast + aria labels.
Aria S.: I'll do an a11y pass and update aria labels + keyboard flow doc.
DesignBot: created ticket: product-ux-4827 — compact min/max controls + burst copy changes.
David K.: can we add a tiny inline preview of expected 95th p95 latency impact when changing SLO? maybe a small sparkline later. not blocking for this iteration.
Marta L.: noted. We'll punt the p95 preview to next sprint. OK to ship updated copy + compact controls behind a feature flag. :shipit: 
Raj P.: thanks all — I'll add the pool validation unit tests and a small e2e to catch the min>max regression.
Aria S.: thanks! will post updated comps by EOD.
Marta L.: awesome — closing thread, will merge decisions into the PR description. :tada:
